title: Inter should rest Calhanoglu at Venezia | Sky has Stankovic starting | Edition No. 57
description:

CONFIRMED — Inter.it (Oct 28): Venezia vs Inter kicks off 1:30 PM ET / 18:30 CET, Serie A matchday 9 at the Stadio Pier Luigi Penzo.
NEXT UP — AC Milan away, Sat Oct 31, 3:45 PM ET / 20:45 CET, US TV: Paramount+ and Telemundo.
